name: easydict-monorepo
description: Shared TypeScript dictionary engine with Alfred, Vicinae and Raycast apps

scripts.build:alfred: npm run build:core && tsc -p apps/alfred && python3 apps/alfred/scripts/build.py
scripts.build:vicinae: npm run build:core && npm run build -w easydict-companion --
scripts.build: npm run build:alfred && npm run build:vicinae && npm run build:raycast
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc -p apps/alfred --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w easydict-companion && npm run typecheck -w felixdict-raycast && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npm run typecheck:python
scripts.test: npm run build:core && tsc -p apps/alfred && node --experimental-strip-types --test test/*.test.ts && python3 -m unittest discover -s test -p "*_test.py"
scripts.build:raycast: npm run build:core && npm run build -w felixdict-raycast
scripts.dev:raycast: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w felixdict-raycast
